findings.title: A transient current_staff_role() failure (including on every tab refocus) switches the whole admin to «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول» and unmounts the open screen
findings.failureScenario: auth-js 2.117.1 `_onVisibilityChanged` → `_recoverAndRefresh` emits SIGNED_IN on every hidden→visible tab change (GoTrueClient.js:4167). Each of these events re-runs evaluate(). Example: the owner is typing in the invite form, the commerce seller form or a document editor, and the laptop sleeps. On wake the tab becomes visible before Wi-Fi is back, so the RPC fails with a fetch error. The gate drops from 'ready' to 'no-role', the children unmount and anything not yet autosaved is lost. The owner then sees 'you do not have access' plus a sign-out button, although his role never changed. The same wrong message appears on first load whenever the network fails.
findings.suggestedFix: In AdminShell.evaluate, tell an RPC error apart from a null role and never downgrade a ready gate on an error: `if (error) { setGate((prev) => (prev.status === 'ready' ? prev : { status: 'no-role' })); return }` and keep `if (!data) setGate({ status: 'no-role' })` for a real missing role.
verifierCorrections: The suggested fix is right as the minimal change: on an RPC error, keep a 'ready' gate as it is, and use no-role only when data is null. On first load an error still falls through to the misleading «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول». Optionally add an error state or a retry, or at least avoid showing the no-access message when `error` is set.

findings.title: Client validation does not match the catalog's DB checks; every violation surfaces as one generic «تحقق من القيم.» with no field named
findings.failureScenario: Values that pass the form's Zod schema but fail migration 20260927160000 checks: coupon code «EID-10» (DB ^[A-Z0-9]{3,32}$), SKU «BOOK 01» (DB ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{0,39}$), product slug «-book» (DB ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,79}$), city_key «1st» or «a» (DB ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$), empty product/variant title or customer name, summary > 500 chars, shipping fee 15,000 ر.س (DB max 1,000,000 halalas, form max 10,000,000), coupon ends_at before starts_at. Save is enabled; the owner gets only «تحقق من القيم.» and cannot tell which field or rule failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Smallest root fix in TableForm.save: on 23514, find the field whose name appears in the PostgREST error message's constraint name (e.g. `coupons_code_check`, `shipping_rates_fee_halalas_check`) and show «<field label>: تحقق من القيمة.»; optionally tighten the few cheap client rules (slug regex to the DB pattern, `max: 1000000` on shipping-rates fee_halalas).
verifierCorrections: Root cause is the rule mismatch, and the form already lists Zod issues per field live (TableForm.tsx:300-311). So the smallest fix mirrors the DB rules on the client: an optional `pattern`/`maxLength`/`nonBlank` on text fields (or a per-table refine) for code, sku, slug and city_key, `max: 1000000` on shipping fee_halalas, a trimmed min(1) on titles and names, max 500 on summary, and a starts_at < ends_at refine on coupons. Mapping the constraint name as a fallback only works for column checks (`coupons_code_check`). Table-level checks get names like `coupons_check2`, so the generic message has to stay for those.

findings.title: Email problems table shows the raw English status 'sent' (and 'pending'/'sending') for bounced/complained rows
findings.failureScenario: outbox_attention() also returns rows `where ... or o.delivery in ('bounced','complained','failed')`. A normal bounce is a row with status 'sent' and delivery 'bounced' (email_event_record only sets delivery), so the الحالة cell reads «sent» next to «ارتد». This is the most common email problem, and it leaves an English code in the Arabic owner UI. outbox_replay() does not clear `delivery`, so a replayed uncertain row that already carried a delivery event also comes back as a raw 'pending' or 'sending'. That contradicts the file's comment that a sending row is never returned.

verifierCorrections: Add `sent: 'أُرسلت'` to STATUS_LABEL in EmailView.tsx:32 (feminine, since it agrees with رسالة). Labels for pending and sending are optional: those statuses cannot actually reach this table.

findings.title: Owner can revoke or demote himself with one click, no confirmation
findings.failureScenario: With two owners, owner A clicks «إيقاف» on his own row, for example within 5 minutes of a previous step-up, when no dialog appears. staff-admin sets active=false and bans A for 876000h, which locks him out immediately; only the other owner can restore him. The last-owner trigger does not help because another owner exists. A role change on his own row to محرر also drops his owner access at once. No confirm() or dialog guards either action.
findings.suggestedFix: In TeamView.tsx, before runAction for set_active with active=false, and for set_role on the signed-in user's own row, ask with `window.confirm(...)` and return when it is refused; or hide these controls on the caller's own row (compare with the session user id).
verifierCorrections: Smallest root-cause fix, with no need to look up the session user id: in the revoke onClick, when member.active is true, run `if (!window.confirm(`إيقاف ${member.display_name}؟`)) return` before runAction. This guards every revoke, the caller's own row included. Leave set_role alone, since it already needs two deliberate actions.
